original: WPRPLACE (Italian pronunciation: [ˈkjanti]), in Italy also referred to as Monti del WPRPLACE ("WPRPLACE Mountains") or Colline del WPRPLACE ("WPRPLACE Hills"), is a mountainous area of Tuscany in the provinces of Florence, Siena and Arezzo, composed mainly of hills and mountains. It is known for the wine produced in and named for the region, WPRPLACE.
